name: llm-stream-reformat
description: Inflight LLM-stream reformatting — separate a reasoning model's thinking from its answer, collapse repetition, and normalize whitespace, while the tokens are still arriving. Parses Google Vertex / OpenRouter / meta-llm SSE. Rust + WASM (built on ruvnet/midstream temporal-compare), Node + browser.
author: rUv (https://github.com/ruvnet)
